title: Right of private defence of property & body
summary: You have the lawful right to protect yourself, your family, and your property from imminent harm or illegal trespass.
fullProvision: Every person has a right, subject to the restrictions contained in Section 106, to defend—(a) his own body, and the body of any other person, against any offence affecting the human body; (b) the property, whether movable or immovable, of himself or of any other person, against any act which is an offence falling under the definition of theft, robbery, mischief or criminal trespass, or which is an attempt to commit theft, robbery, mischief or criminal trespass.
source: Ministry of Law & Justice, Gazette of India (Act No. 45 of 2023)
notes: Corresponds to Sections 97 & 99 of the erstwhile Indian Penal Code, 1860.
